questions.prompt_html: \begin{aligned}\text{设}(X,Y)\text{的联合概率分布为} \\\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|} \hline X\setminus Y & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline 1 & 0 & 3/8 & 3/8 & 0 \\ \hline 3 & 1/8 & 0 & 0 & 1/8 \\ \hline \end{array} \text{则} E(X), E(Y), E(XY) \text{分别为}（ ）.\end{aligned}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \begin{array}{|c|c|c|} \hline \lambda & 1 & 3 \\ \hline p_i & \frac{3}{4} & \frac{1}{4} \\ \hline \end{array} \quad \begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|} \hline y & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\ \hline p_i & \frac{1}{8} & \frac{3}{8} & \frac{3}{8} & \frac{1}{8} \\ \hline \end{array} \quad \text{于是} \quad E(X) = 1 \times \frac{3}{4} + 3 \times \frac{1}{4} = \frac{3}{2}, \\ E(Y) = 0 \times \frac{1}{8} + 1 \times \frac{3}{8} + 2 \times \frac{3}{8} + 3 \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{3}{2}, \\ E(XY) = (1 \times 0) \times 0 + (1 \times 1) \times \frac{3}{8} + (1 \times 2) \times \frac{3}{8} + (1 \times 3) \times 0 \\ + (3 \times 0) \times \frac{1}{8} + (3 \times 1) \times 0 + (3 \times 2) \times 0 + (3 \times 3) \times \frac{1}{8} = \frac{9}{4}. \end{aligned}
